items.text: Jacksonville (early week, extra rest after TNF Wk9): RB Bhayshul Tuten (foot/ankle) and DE Travon Walker (ribs) played through questionable tags; monitor Tuten. IR - S Eric Murray, DT DaVon Hamilton. Deadline adds S Jessie Bates, DT Jordan Davis, DT Davon Godchaux; Coen wants all three ready Sunday. Trevor Lawrence starts.
items.source: NBC Sports/PFT (Coen on getting Bates ready, Nov 10)

items.text: Tennessee (early week, off bye): no major new injuries. Monitor - RB Tyjae Spears (knee, could return), LG Peter Skoronski, RT JC Latham, CB Jaylon Jones (preview list, not an official report). Cam Ward expected to start.
items.source: SI Betting (Jaguars vs. Titans preview, Week 10)
